title: A sprint worker never commits with the git hooks bypassed, and land names a work commit that lacks the hook's trailers
goal: kb-worker's commit rule says the commit hooks run (no --no-verify, no core.hooksPath override), and backlog.py land names a work commit whose message lacks the trailers the commit-msg hook appends, before it pushes. SP-55ddkrrx: the ST-rtmwsqgj worker reported it committed with git hooks bypassed, so its commit had no Session trailer, and land accepted it; the same worker left a lost space ('search ={') that no gate read.
